text: Oi! Just hand over that bike already!\nWe need it to cross this long bridge![VAR 0114(006F)]
We’re gonna use that bike to chase around\nGym Challengers! It’ll be a scream![VAR 0114(006F)]
How barbaric!\c\nIt wouldn’t work anyway. You don’t even have a\nRotom with you!

Hey, young Gym Challenger!
They’re trying to steal my bike!\c
Please, if you could give them a good thrashing,
I would be in your debt!

Oi, we’re not tryin’ to steal the bike!
Only borrow it!\c
We’re gonna use it to chase after
Gym Challengers and make ’em all tired!\c
But I’m thinkin’ you deserve a special shout-out.
I’m gonna crush you in a battle![VAR 0114(006F)]
Gah...\nYou crushed my attempt to crush you.[VAR 0114(006F)]
Why you... I want that bike!\nDon’t get in my way![VAR 0114(006F)]

You’re too strong! If you stay in the Gym
Challenge, you’re gonna cause problems for
our lady!\c
You ’aven’t seen the last of us! We’re gonna
make sure you stay out of our lady’s way![VAR 0114(006F)]

My word, you’re quite the Trainer!\c
And I see you have a Pokédex, too!
That means you have a Rotom with you!\c
Fantastic! I think I’ll give this bike to you, then.
Better you have it than Team Yell!

Now, you know that Rotom love motors
very, very much, right?\c
Enough to jump right into machines that
have motors!\c
So, that got me thinking... If I attached a motor
to a bicycle, then maybe I could get a Rotom to
pop into that as well!
Come now—give it a shot!\c\nEnjoy cycling together with Rotom to the fullest.
Chop, chop, come on now!\c\nYou and Rotom ride that bicycle together!
I’ll read the manual.\c\n“Press the + Button or - Button to ride your bike\nwith Rotom. Let’s get cycling!”
